clips.title: The story
paras: Argos Nightwhisper, a night elf envoy visiting Stormwind, seeks capable adventurers to cross the Great Sea and aid his brother in northern Kalimdor. His brother Gershala studies spreading ecological decay in Darkshore, where fresh hands are desperately needed.

While Stormwind contends with internal turmoil and regional unrest, representatives from the distant kaldorei lands can be found wandering its stone streets. Argos Nightwhisper came seeking seasoned champions willing to look beyond human borders. The kaldorei are relatively new allies to the Eastern Kingdoms, and formal military aid is scarce, leaving family members and researchers to recruit whatever independent champions answer the call.

The destination Argos points toward is Auberdine, a misty port town resting on the fog-shrouded coast of Darkshore. There, his brother Gershala conducts vital research into an ominous malaise afflicting the local wildlife and flora. Answering the summons means a long voyage from Stormwind Harbor across the Great Sea, marking a traveler's first real foray into the ancient wilderness of Kalimdor.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Stormwind -- such a bustling hub of activity.
I have traveled from afar to seek help. Often it is heard that brave adventurers roam these city streets.
My brother, Gershala, requires assistance in Darkshore. He resides in the seaside town of Auberdine.
The journey is a long and epic one. It is for this reason that I ask the help of a seasoned adventurer such as yourself.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, so my brother, Argos, sent you? I realize you must be weary from your travels. But we have much to talk about.
